name: Caroline Logvell
original_name: カロライン　ログヴェル
source:
Carol's beautiful singing and dancing has helped her create a special niche in the hearts of the people. She actively cooperates with the city's vigilante groups and helps protect the people in place of an army of soldiers. Carol's sharp insight and judgement make her out to be a dependable figure, but there is more to her than meets the eye.

[spoiler]She is known as the princess of Alard.[/spoiler]
